programme.title: BA in Computer Science (College of Arts & Sciences)
programme.degree: Bachelor of Arts in Computer Science, College of Arts & Sciences; 15 CS courses plus BU Hub general education; four years
programme.notes: No CS-specific admissions page: english, deadline, tuition and aid come from BU's university-wide undergraduate admissions pages (owner ruling for US universities).

english.quote: Students who are most competitive for admission will have a composite score of at least 90-100 and minimum scores of 20 in each section.
english.notes: TOEFL iBT: 'most competitive' 90-100 composite with 20 in each section (new 1-6 scale from January 21, 2026: 5.0 or higher). IELTS: 'A total/overall score of 7 or higher will also satisfy BU's English Language proficiency requirement for all programs.' DET: 'most competitive ... at least 125-135'. A test is required when English is not the first language.

gpa.notes: No minimum GPA; recommended high-school curriculum only. BU is test-optional for first-year applicants through fall 2028 (https://www.bu.edu/admissions/apply/first-year/).

deadline.quote: First-Year Regular Admission Deadlines Application* January 5
deadline.notes: Year not printed (current cycle, fall 2027). Same deadline for international first-year applicants. Early Decision: November 2; ED2: January 5; some merit scholarships require applying by December 1.

tuition.quote: Billed expenses for the 2026/2027 academic year* Tuition $73,024
tuition.notes: 2027/28 not yet published. Fees $1,570; housing $13,170; food $7,570 (2026/27).

scholarship_exists.quote: International students may be eligible for select merit scholarships offered by BU.
scholarship_exists.notes: Need-based aid exists but only for US citizens/permanent residents; merit scholarships are competitive; some need application by December 1.

scholarship_international.quote: First-Year international students are eligible to apply for merit scholarships
scholarship_international.notes: Merit only: 'Need-based financial aid from BU is not currently available to international students.' (https://www.bu.edu/admissions/tuition-aid/scholarships-financial-aid/).
